description: Schema for a single point observation record (e.g., USGS NWIS streamgage). Each row in the output Parquet file conforms to this schema.

site_id.description: Monitoring location identifier (e.g., USGS site number).

variable.description: Observed variable name, mapped from the provider's parameter code (e.g., '00060' → 'discharge').

value.description: Observed numeric value in the variable's native units.

qualifier.description: Data approval status from the provider (e.g., 'Approved', 'Provisional').

timestamp.description: UTC observation time in ISO 8601 format.

provider.description: Data provider identifier, parsed from the upstream site ID prefix (e.g., 'USGS').
